description: AppTrove SDK for .NET MAUI - Mobile attribution and analytics SDK for iOS and Android. Track installs, events, deep links, and user attribution with ease.
releaseNotes:
v2.0.0:
- Complete SDK rebranding to AppTrove
- Full support for iOS and Android
- Event tracking with custom parameters
- Deferred deep linking with SubscribeAttributionLink
- ParseDeepLink for re-engagement
- Dynamic link creation
- User attribution and profiles
- Push token management (FCM/APN)
